tools.name: revenue_by_month
tools.description: Invoiced revenue and invoice count per month for a date range, excluding void invoices. Use for revenue, sales or billing totals over time.
tools.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', invoice_date)::date AS month,
       COALESCE(SUM(total_amount) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'void'), 0) AS revenue,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'void') AS invoices
  FROM reporting.v_invoices
 WHERE invoice_date BETWEEN :start_date AND :end_date
   AND (:region IS NULL OR region = :region)
 GROUP BY 1
 ORDER BY 1

output.name: revenue
output.description: Invoiced revenue in the month, excluding void invoices.
output.label: Revenue

output.name: invoices
output.description: Number of invoices issued in the month.
output.label: Invoices

tools.resultDescription: One row per month that has invoices, oldest month first.

tools.name: top_unpaid_customers
tools.description: Customers with the largest unpaid invoice balances. Use for who owes the most, accounts receivable or collections questions.
tools.sql:
SELECT customer_name,
       SUM(total_amount - amount_paid) AS balance,
       COUNT(*) AS open_invoices
  FROM reporting.v_invoices
 WHERE status NOT IN ('paid', 'void')
   AND (:region IS NULL OR region = :region)
 GROUP BY customer_name
HAVING SUM(total_amount - amount_paid) > 0
 ORDER BY balance DESC
 LIMIT :limit

output.name: balance
output.description: Unpaid balance across the customer's open invoices.
output.label: Unpaid balance

output.name: open_invoices
output.description: Number of invoices not fully paid.
output.label: Open invoices

tools.resultDescription: One row per customer with an unpaid balance, largest balance first.

tools.name: overdue_invoices
tools.description: Invoices past their due date that aren't fully paid, as of a date. Use for overdue, late or past-due invoice questions.

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: The date to measure lateness on; usually today.

tools.sql:
SELECT invoice_number,
       customer_name,
       due_date,
       total_amount - amount_paid AS balance,
       :as_of - due_date AS days_overdue
  FROM reporting.v_invoices
 WHERE due_date < :as_of
   AND status NOT IN ('paid', 'void')
   AND (:region IS NULL OR region = :region)
 ORDER BY days_overdue DESC, invoice_number
tools.resultDescription: One row per overdue invoice, most overdue first.

tools.name: invoice_details
tools.description: Details of one invoice by its invoice number: customer, dates, amounts and payment status.
tools.sql:
SELECT invoice_number, customer_name, invoice_date, due_date, total_amount, amount_paid, status
  FROM reporting.v_invoices
 WHERE invoice_number = :invoice_number

output.name: status
output.description: Payment status: draft, sent, partially_paid, paid or void.
output.label: Status

tools.resultDescription: One row for the invoice, or no rows if the number doesn't exist.

tools.name: open_tickets_by_priority
tools.description: Number of support tickets that aren't closed, per priority. Use for support backlog or open ticket questions.
tools.sql:
SELECT priority, COUNT(*) AS open_tickets
  FROM dbo.v_tickets
 WHERE status <> 'closed'
 GROUP BY priority
 ORDER BY CASE priority WHEN 'urgent' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'normal' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

output.name: priority
output.description: Ticket priority: urgent, high, normal or low.
output.label: Priority

tools.resultDescription: One row per priority that has open tickets, most urgent first.

tools.name: resolution_time_by_category
tools.description: Average hours to resolve support tickets closed in a date range, per ticket category.
tools.sql:
SELECT category,
       AVG(CAST(hours_to_resolve AS float)) AS avg_hours,
       COUNT(*) AS closed_tickets
  FROM dbo.v_tickets
 WHERE closed_at >= :start_date
   AND closed_at < DATEADD(day, 1, :end_date)
 GROUP BY category
 ORDER BY avg_hours DESC

output.name: category
output.description: Ticket category: billing, login, bug or feature_request.
output.label: Category

output.name: avg_hours
output.description: Average hours from open to close.
output.label: Avg hours

tools.resultDescription: One row per category with closed tickets, slowest first.
